 Due to Listeria Bacteria in Product: Voluntary Recall of Sliced Smoked Salted Frozen Trout Fillet
 Ynet | Print Find an error? Report us The Ministry of Health announced a voluntary recall of the product sliced smoked salted frozen trout fillet 100 grams. According to the ministry, the importer Dealer BMD International Ltd. is calling for the return of the product after the Food Service inspection found Listeria monocytogenes bacteria in the product. Its expiration date is June 24, 2027, the production date is June 24, 2026, the shipment code is 5161/240616/2026 and the barcode is 4810168045586. Consumers who purchased the product are requested not to consume it.
